text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: HIGH - inference-service error-rate spike detected. Service: inference-api-prod. Trigger: 5xx > 8% over 5m. PagerDuty incident: PD-94827. Auto-page to oncall.

pagerduty: Incoming page -> PD-94827
Summary: inference-api-prod: 5xx spike (>=8%)
Urgency: high
Service owner: inference-team
Actions: page sent to redispatch schedule

dana (oncall): Acked PD-94827. I'm on it, pinging SRE.

maya: Seeing alerts in datadog too, I can pull traces. linking dashboards: https://dd/redwood/inference-api/errors & host map.

sam (sre): On standby, will join in 2 min. Any customer-facing impact?

lee (cs): Customer ops: getting a few tickets about slow responses from hosted API, two customers reported timeouts. Notified priority customers.

dana (oncall): Initial check: 95% of 5xx are 502 from model-proxy-*/pods. Error rate started 10:12 UTC. Rolling restarts might be happening due to OOMs? K8s events show repeated evictions on node-gpu-7.

ops-bot: k8s-event: pod/model-proxy-12 - OOMKilled - node node-gpu-7 - 10:11:23 UTC

jordan (prod): Can we route traffic away from node-gpu-7? If it's a hardware/driver flake, we should cordon and drain. Also consider failover to fallback model variant (smaller quantized) while we recover.

maya: Pulling logs from model-proxy-12 -> recent stack: 
```
2026-03-14T10:11:20Z ERROR kv-cache: failed allocate 1.2G
2026-03-14T10:11:21Z ERROR inference: failing request id=abc123 status=502 msg="kv cache OOM"
```

dana (oncall): Taking immediate mitigations: 1) scale up inference-proxy replica count + add pod anti-affinity; 2) cordon node-gpu-7 and drain; 3) route a portion of traffic to fallback-model-quant2. Executing now.

sam (sre): I'm doing step 1 (scale). runbook link: https://confluence/redwood/runbooks/inference-502-oom. Commands:
```
kubectl scale deployment inference-proxy -n prod --replicas=12
kubectl cordon node-gpu-7
kubectl drain node-gpu-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

ops-bot: scale job started (deployment/inference-proxy -> 12 replicas).

incident-bot: Escalation timer started -> will escalate to SRE lead in 8m if not acked.

lee (cs): Notifying affected customers with temporary mitigation note.

jordan (prod): I'll flip the routing to fallback-model-quant2 for 20% of traffic via the smart-router. Doing gradual 5% steps. Monitor latency.

maya: Telemetry update: 10:16 UTC after scale/drain -> 5xx dropped from 9.5% to 2.1% (first 3 minutes). Latency for fallback model +120ms but error rate down.

dana (oncall): Good. Keeping watch. Will keep PD incident open while we validate stability for 30m.

pagerduty: PD-94827 acknowledged by dana (oncall).

incident-bot: Post-update: automated runbook recommends checking GPU driver versions on node-gpu-7 and GPU memory tracking.

sam (sre): I've pulled driver logs; there are GPU memory allocation failures in the kernel logs on node-gpu-7. Suspect memory leak in model-proxy on high-concurrency edge cases. Opening a bug: BUG-2114.

jordan (prod): For mitigation, propose config change: limit max-concurrency for model-proxy to 12 per pod and enable early OOM mitigation in runtime. Can test on stage and then prod.

dana (oncall): @sam, can you take primary ownership? I need to handoff in 18m for shift change. I'll stay as secondary and keep PD notified.

sam (sre): I can take it. Acking ownership. Will post updates every 10 minutes until stable, then coordinate postmortem.

incident-bot: Ownership update: primary -> sam (sre), secondary -> dana (oncall). PagerDuty notes updated.

lee (cs): Thanks, dana + sam. Customer comms: will send a follow-up to impacted customers in 30m with status and ETA for full resolution.

sam (sre): Mitigation actions planned: a) apply concurrency cap config to a canary subset (2 pods), b) deploy a small patch to release memory earlier, c) monitor for regressions. Rolling now.

ops-bot: canary deploy applied to inference-proxy-22 and inference-proxy-23.

maya: Observability: after canary patch, 10:31 UTC -> canary error rate 0.2%, host-level memory stable. Canary looks good.

sam (sre): Starting progressive rollout of patch to 50% of pods. Will watch for 5 minutes per step.

dana (oncall): Leaving handoff notes in PagerDuty: shift end, primary -> sam. If escalation needed, page SRE-lead. Good luck. :coffee:

pagerduty: Note added to PD-94827: "dana (oncall) handed off to sam (sre) - monitoring continues"

sam (sre): Rollout complete at 10:45 UTC. Error rates back to baseline <0.5%. Memory metrics stable. Rolling restart unnecessary. Keeping PD open for postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident status: Mitigated -> error-rate reduced below threshold. Monitoring period active for 30m.

lee (cs): Sending customer update: "We've mitigated the error spike affecting inference API. Fallback routing and scaling were used to limit impact. We're investigating root cause and will follow up."

jordan (prod): Created follow-up ticket TKT-5020: investigate memory leak in model-proxy, plan targeted fix + extended load testing. Assigning to sam + runtime team.

sam (sre): Closing notes for now: primary owner sam (sre), secondary dana (oncall). Next steps: reproduce leak in staging, add regression test, patch runtime. Postmortem scheduled tomorrow 15:00 UTC.

incident-bot: PD-94827 status changed to "resolved" by sam (sre) at 10:58 UTC.

sam (sre): Resolved. Will publish postmortem and link to follow-up ticket. Thanks everyone for quick responses. :thumbsup:

lee (cs): Great work team.

maya: Adding logs/artifacts to the incident doc now.

-- end of thread --
